scripts.agent-image:ref: uv run python scripts/images.py ref agent
scripts.verifier-image:ref: uv run python scripts/images.py ref verifier
scripts.bench:local:tempo: uv run python scripts/run_benchmark.py local-oracle-dev --no-sync --task-suite tempo
scripts.bench:local:mpp: uv run python scripts/run_benchmark.py local-oracle-dev --no-sync --task-suite mpp
scripts.bench:local:mcp: uv run python scripts/run_benchmark.py local-agent --task-suite tempo-mcp --profile mcp-both
scripts.bench:local:all: uv run python scripts/run_benchmark.py local-oracle-dev --no-sync --task-suite all
scripts.bench:matrix:dev: uv run python scripts/run_benchmark.py production-daytona --models-config config/models.dev.yaml --n-attempts 1
scripts.bench:matrix:production: uv run python scripts/run_benchmark.py production-daytona --models-config config/models.production.yaml --n-attempts 3
scripts.check: npm run check:scripts && npm run test:results && npm run test:evalkit && npm run check:evalkit && npm run test:tempo-verifier && npm run check:mcp-types && npm run test:mcp-bridge && npm run check:shell && npm run task:lint && npm run check:docs && npm run check:format && npm run check:lint
scripts.check:docs: npm run docs:prepare && npm run docs:check
scripts.check:evalkit: uv run python -m evalkit.cli check tempo-v1 tempo-mcp-v1 mpp
scripts.check:shell: git ls-files -z -- '*.sh' | xargs -0 uv run shellcheck --severity=warning
scripts.test:results: uv run python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p '*_test.py'
scripts.test:evalkit: uv run coverage run -m unittest discover -s evalkit -p '*_test.py' && uv run coverage report && uv run coverage report --include='evalkit/compiler/*' --fail-under=99
scripts.test:tempo-verifier: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix shared/tempo/verifier && npm test --prefix shared/tempo/verifier
